name: Ring of Glass Fists
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring looks like a ring of mighty blows and functions as such. On a successful unarmed attack, however, the wearer also suffers 1d6 points of damage.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of shatter and remove curse upon it, destroying the ring.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of mighty blows

Identification DC 28
False Identification DC 18
